fullPassage: Morality has been associated with the rational human beings for more than one reason. Perhaps the most prominent one is that animals seem to lack the one quality that is thought to be essential: the intention to do something just because it is right. We are not talking here about animals that have been trained to be obedient — they only act the way they do because of reward expectations — but about animals that seem to naturally act in a way that benefits others. We see acts of apparent kindness among animals all the time: primates grooming each other, dolphins supporting a sick companion, elephants comforting a distressed calf. But what looks like morality may just be instinct. An animal doesn't pause to consider what is ethical; it simply responds. The key question is whether these animals are choosing to do good, or whether they are simply following biological impulses that happen to produce behavior we interpret as moral.

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 right의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 올바른 — (B) 오른쪽의: (A) 사과하는 것이 가장 올바른(도덕적) 일이었다 + (B) 다음 교차로에서 오른쪽으로 돌아라 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 정확한 — (B) 바로: (A)의 문맥은 도덕적 올바름이지 정확성 아님
❌ ③ (A) 오른쪽의 — (B) 올바른: 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ④ (A) 바로 — (B) 정확한: 두 문맥 모두 부적절
det.tip: right: ① 올바른/옳은(morally correct) ② 오른쪽의(direction) ③ 정확한(correct) ④ 바로(immediately)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "an inborn pattern of behavior that is characteristic of a species and is often a response to specific environmental stimuli"

det.korean: 종의 특성인 타고난 행동 패턴 = instinct(본능)
det.analysis:
❌ ① morality — 도덕성. 타고난 행동 패턴과 직접 관련 없음
✅ ② instinct — 본능. 종의 특성인 타고난 행동 패턴으로 특정 환경 자극에 대한 반응이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ intention — 의도. 의식적 결정이므로 '타고난 행동 패턴'과 다름
❌ ④ impulse — 충동. 유사하지만 종의 특성(characteristic of a species)이라는 정의에 instinct이 더 정확
det.tip: instinct(본능) — 종 특유의 타고난 행동 양식. impulse(충동)는 일시적 반응

questions.passage: We are not talking here about animals that have been trained to be obedient — they only act the way they do because of reward __________ (expect).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: expect → expectations: 전치사 of 뒤에 명사가 필요. reward expectations(보상 기대)
det.analysis: reward __________(expect): 전치사 of의 목적어이자 reward의 수식을 받는 명사 자리. expect(동사) → expectations(명사, 기대)로 변환. 복수형 expectations가 자연스러움
det.tip: because of reward expectations — of 뒤에 명사 필요. expect(동사) → expectation(명사) → expectations(복수)

questions.passage: The key question is whether these animals are __________ (choose) to do good, or whether they are simply following biological impulses.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: choose → choosing: are + V-ing 진행형 구문. are choosing(선택하고 있는 중인지)
det.analysis: are __________(choose): be동사 are 뒤에 현재분사가 와서 진행형(are choosing) 구성. 뒤의 are simply following과 병렬 구조
det.tip: are choosing to do good — are + V-ing 진행형. choose(원형) → choosing(현재분사)

questions.passage: Morality has been associated with the rational human beings for more than one reason. Perhaps the most prominent one is that animals seem to lack the one quality that is thought to be essential: the intention to do something just because it is right. We are not talking here about animals that have been trained to be obedient — they only act the way they do because of __________ — but about animals that seem to naturally act in a way that benefits others. We see acts of apparent kindness among animals all the time: primates grooming each other, dolphins supporting a sick companion, elephants comforting a distressed calf. But what looks like morality may just be instinct. An animal doesn't pause to consider what is ethical; it simply responds. The key question is whether these animals are choosing to do good, or whether they are simply following biological impulses that happen to produce behavior we interpret as moral.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 훈련된 동물은 보상 기대(reward expectations) 때문에 행동한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① social pressure — 사회적 압력. 동물 훈련의 동기로 부적절
✅ ② reward expectations — 보상 기대. 훈련받은 동물이 행동하는 이유는 보상을 기대하기 때문이라는 맥락에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ moral reasoning — 도덕적 추론. 본문에서 동물은 도덕적 추론 능력이 없다고 주장
❌ ④ emotional bonds — 정서적 유대. 훈련된 동물의 행동 동기로 부적절
det.tip: they only act the way they do because of ______(보상 기대) — 훈련받은 동물의 행동 동기

questions.passage: Morality has been associated with the rational human beings for more than one reason. Perhaps the most prominent one is that animals seem to lack the one quality that is thought to be essential: the intention to do something just because it is right. We are not talking here about animals that have been trained to be obedient — they only act the way they do because of reward expectations — but about animals that seem to naturally act in a way that benefits others. We see acts of apparent kindness among animals all the time: primates grooming each other, dolphins supporting a sick companion, elephants comforting a distressed calf. But what looks like morality may just be instinct. An animal doesn't pause to consider what is ethical; it simply responds. The key question is whether these animals are choosing to do good, or whether they are simply following __________ that happen to produce behavior we interpret as moral.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 도덕적이라고 해석되는 행동을 만들어내는 생물학적 충동(biological impulses)
det.analysis:
❌ ① rational judgments — 이성적 판단. 글은 동물이 이성적 판단을 하지 않는다고 서술
❌ ② learned behaviors — 학습된 행동. 훈련된 동물과 구별되는 자연적 행동 맥락에서 부적절
❌ ③ cultural norms — 문화적 규범. 동물에게 문화적 규범을 적용하는 것은 부적절
✅ ④ biological impulses — 생물학적 충동. 동물이 도덕적으로 보이는 행동을 만들어내는 생물학적 충동을 따르는 것인지가 핵심 질문 ←정답
det.tip: following ______(생물학적 충동) that happen to produce behavior we interpret as moral — 본능적 반응
